about: Batch 3b (the Common Room's and My Room's evening and night) written early on 7 Oct 2026 at the owner's word, from the two day pictures the owner chose in 3a, which are NOT installed: art_batch.write_batch(data, '3b', record, manifest, out, preview=True, root=<a scratch root>) with the chosen pictures fitted to 1920x1080 as that root's game/images/bg/dorm_common.png and your_room.png, and a scratch manifest putting both at revision 2 or more. Judge the results with tools/py_art.sh tools/install_redo.py --relight <place> <evening|night> <a> <b> --dry --against <the chosen day picture>, then by eye.
